name: The Pledge of the Moon
description: The third pledge, and the one kept at night. A shallow bowl of pale stone sits in a ring of flat ground, and the ring is raked, and the raking is fresh. Whatever is promised here is promised by moonlight and checked by it.

pois.label: Pale bowl
pois.text: Shallow, wider than two arms, and dry. The inside is marked in concentric rings that do not line up with the bowl's shape. Filled, it would hold a depth of about a hand.

pois.label: Raked ring
pois.text: Lines in the ground running out from the bowl in every direction, all of them ending at the same distance. The rake is leaning against a stone at the edge, tines down.

pois.label: Moon mark
pois.text: A disc cut into a standing stone at the ring's edge, worn smooth in the centre. Someone has been pressing a palm to it and the smoothness is palm-shaped.
